conditions: must be made with an OCBC Card.
Valid for all OCBC Cards issued in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Hong Kong and Macau.
Valid for dine-in and takeaway (where applicable), but not for delivery.
For Suki-ya and Suki Suki Hotpot promotions: All diners at the table must order the premium buffet top-up to enjoy the promotion.
Minimum spend requirements exclude service change and prevailing government taxes (GST).
Not valid on eves of and on public holidays and other blackout dates and festivals as determined by the restaurant.
Not valid in conjunction with other offers, set lunches, discounts, privileges or vouchers including grab dine-out discounts or vouchers.
Only one redemption is allowed per bill per table. Splitting or combining of bills and/or tables is strictly not allowed.
